title: augo vs Vekta: which coaching platform is right for you? (2026)
seoTitle: augo vs Vekta: Endurance Coaching Platforms Compared (2026)
description: augo vs Vekta: chat, session feedback, AI, strength, devices and price compared. See which coaching platform fits how you coach.
bodyHtml:
Short answer: Vekta and augo are both endurance coaching platforms, but they solve different problems. Vekta is built around performance analytics, like Critical Power and automatic interval detection, and is popular with pro cycling teams. augo is built around the coach-athlete relationship: chat, custom session feedback, how the athlete feels, an in-app AI assistant, and matching that brings new athletes to coaches. Pick Vekta if you coach watts. Pick augo if you coach people.

Updated November 2026

If you coach runners, triathletes or cyclists and you're looking for a TrainingPeaks alternative, here is how the two compare, where each one is stronger, and what they cost.

augo vs Vekta at a glance

What is Vekta?

Vekta is an AI training and analysis platform for endurance sport. It replaces FTP with Critical Power and W′ models that update every day, and uses AI to detect intervals, classify sessions and write summaries. Several WorldTour cycling teams use it, and Chris Froome is on its team. Vekta started in cycling and later added running and swimming.

What is augo?

augo is a coaching platform for running, cycling and triathlon coaches and their athletes. It puts conversations, session feedback, training data and wellness in one place, so a coach sees both the numbers and how the athlete is doing. An in-app AI assistant helps coaches plan, review and reply faster, and augo's matching helps athletes find the right coach. Athletes use augo for free.

Which elite coaches use augo?

Elite coaches in running, triathlon and cycling already coach their athletes on augo:

  • Dr. Marco Altini coaches runners. He is a researcher, the founder of HRV4Training and an advisor to Oura, and one of the best-known voices on HRV and training.
  • Gordon Crawford coaches triathlon. He is Performance Director at Triathlon Ireland, a former Swiss Triathlon national coach, and has coached several Olympians.
  • Reto Brändli coaches triathlon and cycling. He has coached several Ironman champions.

Key differences between augo and Vekta

Can coaches and athletes chat on Vekta?

Not really. On Vekta, coach and athlete can leave comments back and forth on a single workout. There is no inbox and no ongoing conversation. On augo, chat is the heart of the app: every athlete in one inbox, with text, photos and voice notes (with transcripts), right next to the sessions they're talking about. The assistant remembers past conversations, so context doesn't get lost.

Can coaches choose what athletes report after a session?

On augo, yes. Coaches pick the feedback questions: how the session felt, how it went against expectations, RPE, aches, and real fuelling data like what the athlete ate before and how many carbs per hour they took. Vekta has a fixed daily wellness check-in, so coaches can't choose what athletes report, and nutrition isn't captured. Vekta does suggest a carb target per session, but that's a plan, not what the athlete actually ate.

Which platform has better AI for coaches?

They use AI differently. Vekta uses AI mostly for analysis: interval detection, race detection, session comparison and summaries. augo has an in-app assistant that can do most of what a general AI tool like Claude can: answer questions about any athlete, build workouts and full training blocks, draft messages and flag who needs attention today. augo also has a ready-made connector for Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini. Vekta offers a public API that technical users can connect to tools like Claude Code.

Which is better for performance analysis?

Vekta. Its Critical Power, W′ balance, durability and adaptive zones go deeper than augo's analysis, which covers intervals, splits, zones and trends. If lab-grade power analysis is the core of how you coach, Vekta is built for that.

Do augo and Vekta support strength training?

augo does. Coaches can build strength sessions with sets, reps, rest, cues and a demo video for each exercise. On Vekta, a strength session is text and links, and athletes can only mark it as done.

Which watches and wellness devices do they connect to?

augo connects to Garmin, Apple Watch, Coros, Polar, Whoop, Oura, Zwift, Rouvy, Wahoo, Strava, Hammerhead and Suunto. Vekta connects to Garmin, Wahoo, Oura, Whoop, Zwift, Hammerhead and Coros.

Can a coaching platform help you get more athletes?

augo can. Athletes looking for a coach can find and get matched with one inside augo, so coaches grow their roster from the platform. Vekta has no marketplace and no matching. It saves time on the athletes you already have, but finding new ones is up to you.

How much do augo and Vekta cost?

The models are different. augo charges the coach $12 (€9) per athlete a month, and athletes use the app for free. Vekta is free for coaches, and every athlete pays their own subscription of €19.99 a month or €179.99 a year. For a coach with 20 athletes, that's €180 a month on augo, paid by the coach, vs about €400 a month on Vekta, paid by the athletes. On augo, the AI assistant is included in that price. See augo pricing.

augo or Vekta: which should you choose?

Choose Vekta if:

  • You coach cyclists and power analysis is the core of your coaching
  • You want Critical Power, W′ and durability models without extra software
  • You work with a pro or development team that already uses it
  • Your athletes are happy to pay for their own subscription

Choose augo if:

  • You want all athlete conversations, feedback and training in one place
  • You care about how athletes feel, what they eat and what's going on in their lives, not only their power numbers
  • You want an AI assistant inside the app that helps you plan, review and reply
  • You coach runners, triathletes or mixed rosters, including strength work
  • You want athletes to use the app for free
  • You want help growing your roster

Switching from TrainingPeaks

Many coaches compare augo and Vekta because they're leaving TrainingPeaks, now owned by Garmin. Both offer help with the move. On augo, the team moves your workout library over in a 10-minute call, and your athletes' training history is imported automatically. You can try augo free for 14 days before you pay.

Frequently asked questions

What is the difference between augo and Vekta?

Vekta focuses on performance analytics, like Critical Power and AI interval detection. augo focuses on the coach-athlete relationship: chat, custom session feedback, wellness, an in-app AI assistant and coach matching.

Is augo a good Vekta alternative?

Yes, if you want more than analytics. augo adds a full coach-athlete inbox, feedback questions you choose, fuelling tracking, strength sessions with demo videos and help finding new athletes, and it's free for athletes.

Is Vekta free for coaches?

Yes. Vekta doesn't charge coaches. Each athlete pays €19.99 a month or €179.99 a year.

How much does augo cost?

augo costs the coach $12 (€9) per athlete a month, with a 14-day free trial. Athletes use the app for free, and the AI assistant is included. See augo pricing.

Does Vekta have a chat between coach and athlete?

Only comments on individual workouts. There is no inbox or ongoing conversation like augo's.

Can I track nutrition and fuelling with my athletes?

On augo, yes. Coaches can ask athletes what they ate before a session and how many carbs per hour they took. Vekta gives a carb target per session but doesn't capture what the athlete actually ate.

Does augo work with Apple Watch?

Yes. augo works with Apple Watch, Garmin, Coros, Wahoo, Polar, Strava and Zwift. Vekta doesn't support Apple Watch or Polar.

Can I use augo with Claude or ChatGPT?

Yes. augo has a connector for Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini, so coaches can ask about athletes, build training blocks and draft messages from there. augo also has its own AI assistant inside the app.

Can I move from TrainingPeaks to augo or Vekta?

Yes, both help with the move. augo moves your workout library in a 10-minute call and imports your athletes' history automatically.
